maria_csm: Kicking off Solstice Health onboarding. They're deploying Redwood Private into their VPC for PHI. Goal: 7-week go-live. Owners: Maria (CSM), Devin (SE), Lina (Ops), Sam (Enablement). Please confirm.

maria_csm: Key success criteria: VPC peering + private endpoints validated; SAML + SCIM working; PHI mapping signed off; training + runbook delivered; pilot p50 <300ms.

devin_se: Ian own integration and test harness. Need sample payloads and SAML metadata from customer. Will draft integration checklist by Friday.

lina_ops: Ian own infra checklist and certs. Note: if customer manages KMS, cert provisioning may take 3-5 business days.

sam_cs: Enablement will run two 60m sessions (dev + ops) and produce quickstart + recording.

maria_csm: Actions: Maria request SAML+payloads (Tue); Devin integration checklist (Fri); Lina infra checklist (Wed); Sam schedule trainings (next Thu).
